surface_features: counterargument cites specific data, studies, statistics, named cases or documented examples
constructs.domain: Reddit r/ChangeMyView counterarguments to OP posts

features.name: any_comment_specific_empirical_evidence
features.definition: Does at least one counterargument comment contain specific empirical evidence, such as particular data, statistics, studies, or documented concrete cases?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment itself offers specific empirical evidence against/in response to the OP's view: concrete statistics or figures, named or described studies/reports, documented historical or real-world cases, or verifiable factual data (a cited external source counts as support). Return 0 if comments only give reasoning, opinion, hypotheticals, generic assertions or anecdotes without specific verifiable detail. Use title and argument only to interpret the comment's target. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates and reports of the outcome as evidence; generic delta-rule discussion is eligible. Empty or unparseable list: empty list gives 0, malformed/missing gives null.

h0: any_comment_specific_empirical_evidence has no association with the likelihood of delta.
h1: Rows with any_comment_specific_empirical_evidence=1 have a higher likelihood of delta than rows with 0.
note: Operational assumption: "a counterargument" is measured as any available comment in the row containing such evidence. Comments are unordered, without scores or timestamps; the available comments may not be the one that earned the delta, and comments may include later replies or outcome-related text (excluded semantically). Association only, not causal. OLS on a binary outcome is a linear probability model.
